author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
I was looking at some of my old maps and found this. It was a map concept of "Laser Tag" that me and my brother made

Made By: Sethskye and MinecraftIdiot

You need to work as a team to get as many kills as possible using only a BOW

You spawn with No Sword
Power 100 Bow(Infinite + arrow)
64 Steak


Images: http://imgur.com/a/ti6vh
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/bgkytrnt1dy5cit/Seth8.rar
YML: http://pastebin.com/yPHgiTPL
